findings.title: Analytics has no consent-mode signalling and no documented event/retention governance
evidence: apps/web/app/(public)/layout.tsx:65-67 gtag('config', GA_ID) with default storage (no consent state passed)
apps/web/app/(public)/privacy/page.tsx:29-31 states IP address and pages visited are collected automatically
git ls-files for analytics governance docs found only product/prompt catalogs, not a live event schema or retention basis
findings.impact: There is no consent-state wiring and no documented retention or purpose limitation for analytics data, so analytics collection cannot be shown to be lawful or minimal.
findings.recommendation: Adopt a consent-state contract, document each event's purpose and retention, and add the event schema to the data-governance docs.
